description: For repositories on GitHub, run by the Mend app: it passes about once a day at a time of its choosing, so a night window would be missed, and nothing there touches the homelab

packageRules.description: Patches, digests, pins and lock file maintenance merge themselves once CI passes, after the release age of the default preset; majors stay manual
Minors merge themselves the same way, except on 0.x versions, where a minor can break
